channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Cyberattacks continue to menace Japan as more firms disclose data breaches
item.description: More firms have disclosed details of data breaches that could affect millions of customers.

item.title: Japan’s leader says she loses hours to makeup and chores. Opinions abound.
item.description: Sanae Takaichi said she has a busier schedule than her male predecessors, a nod to the disproportionate share of household tasks in Japan that fall to women.

item.title: U.S. holds more secret talks with Myanmar’s military-backed rulers in Tokyo, sources say
item.description: It was their second meeting in a month as Washington steps up reengagement with the generals it shunned after their 2021 coup.

item.title: Russia may seek prisoner swap after detaining Japanese journalist
item.description: Some say the detention of the reporter is linked to the handover to Germany this month of a Russian hacker detained in Japan in May.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
